offers_products.reason: Sells prepared food, steaks, sushi and cocktails at STK, Benihana, Kona Grill and RA Sushi restaurants.

offers_services.reason: Revenue is mainly restaurant food and drink sales; licensing, management and franchising are a smaller side.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Diners and families choose and eat at its restaurants such as Benihana and STK.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Restaurant guests are individuals; franchisees and licensees are only a small side channel.

recurring_revenue.reason: Upscale celebration and experience dining is occasional, with no contracts or subscriptions.

cyclical_demand.reason: Dining out at upscale steakhouses and teppanyaki restaurants is discretionary and easily cut in a downturn.

big_ticket.reason: A restaurant meal is a small, frequent purchase.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for food, drink and the restaurant venue, not mainly staff time.

large_customers.reason: Customers are individual diners and households.

asset_heavy.reason: Growth needs building and fitting out many company-operated restaurants, with leased or owned sites and kitchen equipment.
